title: BQDNA: Multi-Head Binary Spherical Quantization for Genomic Sequence Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.29395v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decoding biological information from long, repetitive DNA remains challenging. Genomic language models (gLMs) often follow the conventional language-model pretrain-and-adapt paradigm. However, the lack of inherent semantic segmentation and prior rules makes hand-crafted tokenizers like k-mer and BPE suboptimal. We introduce context-aware \textbf{BQVAE} for scalar quantization of DNA and \textbf{BQDNA}, an autoregressive gLM supporting multi-head codebooks. Comprehensive experiments reveal that: (1) unique training dynamics of vector quantization in DNA space, including the importance of alignment between training corpus and downstream data. (2) superior performance of BQVAE over hand-crafted tokenizers and vanilla VQVAE. (3) remarkable cross-species generalization capability of BQDNA, which achieves state-of-the-art performance with merely 0.1B multi-species training for BQVAE and 1 epoch training on hg38 for BQDNA, outperforming gLMs

translated_title: BQDNA：用于基因组序列建模的多头二进制球面量化方法
translated_abstract: 从冗长且重复的DNA序列中解码生物信息仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。基因组语言模型（gLMs）通常遵循传统的语言模型预训练-适应范式。然而，由于DNA缺乏固有的语义分割和先验规则，k-mer和BPE等手工设计的分词器并非最优选择。我们提出了具有上下文感知能力的BQVAE用于DNA的标量量化，以及BQDNA——一个支持多头码本的自回归基因组语言模型。全面的实验揭示：（1）DNA空间中向量量化存在独特的训练动态，包括训练语料与下游数据对齐的重要性；（2）BQVAE的性能优于手工设计的分词器和原始VQVAE；（3）BQDNA具有显著的跨物种泛化能力，仅需0.1B参数的多物种训练用于BQVAE、以及在hg38上仅1个epoch的训练用于BQDNA，即可达到最先进的性能，超越现有基因组语言模型。
tldr: 提出了基于上下文感知多头二进制球面量化的分词器BQVAE及自回归基因组语言模型BQDNA，以极少的训练数据和计算量实现了最先进的基因组建模性能和出色的跨物种泛化能力。
en_tdlr: BQDNA is an autoregressive genomic language model built on a context-aware multi-head binary spherical quantization tokenizer (BQVAE), achieving state-of-the-art performance and remarkable cross-species generalization with minimal training data and compute.
